w01.why: Stacked ridge lines drawn as continuous polylines, where one large smooth hump in the lower middle stands apart from the jagged small peaks elsewhere, with no evenly spaced fast oscillation.

w02.why: A fine row-by-row colour field whose broad light and dark bands vary slowly, broken by one singular near-black row below the middle; the only extra element is an unlabeled colour ramp.

w03.why: A fine colour field whose evenly spaced diagonal light-dark stripes repeat across every row, with one red-highlighted row as the singular event.

w04.why: Many hundreds of dots in grey cells form a band with one tall spike, and the strip below alternates large and small squares at an even spacing.

w05.why: A grid of roughly 48 by 23 shaded blocks (a few hundred carry data) with one tall dark spike column, above a strip of evenly alternating dark and light squares.

w06.why: Coarse grey blocks (about 19 columns by 6 rows) filled with faint, irregular hairline hatching, where one column rises above the rest; the dot row underneath reads as an axis, not as a drawn alternation.

w07.why: Continuous stacked curves with one line picked out in red for its hump, plus an inset scatter of many small, evenly repeating wiggles that rises to a spike.

w08.why: Many hundreds of paired dots in cells form a band with one tall isolated spike column, and no alternating strip is drawn.

w09.why: Smooth stacked curves with point markers whose slow, similar waves show only a mild bump on the left, with nothing emphasised and no fast alternation.

w10.why: A barcode of hundreds of fine vertical lines per row, where one column block alone reaches the top rows; the lines are irregular, and the ruler ticks are an axis.

w11.why: Hundreds of colour-coded dashes on fine rows, with red dashes marking one row and two dark vertical paths, plus an inset scatter of small, evenly repeating wiggles with a spike.

w12.why: Many hundreds of scattered dots in about 19 by 6 cells, where one densely filled cell pair at the top stands apart from the sparse empty top rows.
